claim: Europe PMC is an external free life-sciences literature search resource providing access to trusted literature sources, including abstracts and full text where available.
future_grounding_route: Europe PMC search hits can be used to identify data-availability statements and queued dataset leads; any scientific claim still requires project grounding or explicit external labeling.
project_use: Published-paper and supplement mining for MS cohorts and prior-art context.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Free literature search with full-text mining routes useful for data-availability statement discovery.
why_unverifiable: Europe PMC's literature corpus, text-mining, and source aggregation are external to the project's rerunnable data pipeline.
